intended_object: This is a helper for proofs about P2 cuts of cyclic surface presentations. It turns an index in the cut word that lies past the left piece into a local index in the right piece by subtracting the left length. This is inferred from the docstring and the body.
explanation: The definition only does index bookkeeping. It takes the position `positiveCutSideIndex … i`, subtracts `cut.left.length`, and packages the result as an element of `Fin cut.right.length`, with an `omega` proof that the bound holds. It is an implementation detail of the library's own construction for the classification of surfaces. It has no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so judging it as faithful or not does not apply.
